name: How long does kitchen painting and trim work usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen painting and trim work usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most small kitchen painting and trim projects take a few days, while larger projects can take longer depending on drying time, repairs, and how much cabinetry is involved. The schedule also depends on whether the work is done on-site or with parts removed and refinished off-site.
acceptedAnswer.description: A simple project may take several days; larger kitchens or heavy prep can take longer. Drying time and repairs are the biggest schedule factors.
